routes.title: Free Portfolio Website & Resume Builder — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Build a portfolio website, ATS-friendly resume and cover letter free in your browser. Export HTML, PDF, Word or a full site. No sign-up, works offline.
routes.h1: Free portfolio website and resume builder that runs in your browser
routes.intro: Portfolio OS lets you design a professional portfolio website, write an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, and export everything as HTML, PDF, Word (DOCX) or a deploy-ready static site. There is no sign-up, nothing is uploaded, and it works offline.
points: Portfolio website builder with designed templates, themes and drag-and-drop sections
Resume builder with 18 print-grade templates, ATS checks and real pagination
Cover letters and documents that share one profile with your portfolio
Export to standalone HTML, PDF, DOCX, a ZIP website, or Next.js and Vite source code
Private by design: your data stays in your browser

routes.title: Free ATS-Friendly Resume Builder — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Make a professional resume free: 18 templates including ATS-friendly designs, example content, JSON Resume import, and PDF, Word and TXT export. No sign-up.
routes.h1: Free resume builder with ATS-friendly templates
routes.intro: Pick a resume template, start from realistic example content or import a JSON Resume file, then tailor a version for every job. Resume Studio checks ATS compatibility, keeps entries together across pages and exports PDF, Word, plain text and JSON.
points: 18 resume templates: Corner Portrait, Geometric Banner, Teal Stripe, Slate Banner, Navy Sidebar, ATS Minimal and more
ATS and content checks for headings, dates, length and keywords
Fit to one page, page limits and repeated section headings
Import JSON Resume files and export PDF, DOCX, TXT and JSON
Application pack: resume, cover letter and portfolio in one ZIP

routes.title: Free Portfolio Website Templates — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Free, customisable portfolio website templates for developers, designers, writers and consultants. Edit themes and layouts, then export HTML or a site.
routes.intro: Each portfolio template comes with its own layout, section order, motion and a realistic sample persona you can rewrite. Switch themes, fonts and spacing at any time, then export a standalone HTML file, PDF, Word document or deploy-ready website.
points: Templates for developers, designers, writers, illustrators, architects and consultants
Light and dark themes with tunable colour, type, spacing and motion
Responsive previews for desktop, tablet and phone
Export to HTML, PDF, DOCX, ZIP or framework source code

routes.title: Free Cover Letter & Document Builder — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Write cover letters, case studies, proposals and reports with free templates. Uses your resume profile and exports to PDF or Word.
routes.intro: Document Studio turns your shared profile into cover letters, case studies, proposals, project reports and portfolio PDFs. Choose from 10 document templates and 4 cover letter templates, then export to PDF or DOCX.
points: 4 cover letter templates and 10 document templates
Block editor with headings, tables, timelines, stats and project cards
Uses the same profile, experience and projects as your resume
Vector PDF and editable Word export

routes.title: Create a Portfolio Website in Minutes — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Start a portfolio website from a template, a blank page, your resume text or an existing HTML page. Free, private and no sign-up needed.
routes.intro: Start from a designed template, a blank page, pasted resume text or an existing HTML page. Your portfolio is saved in your browser and can be exported any time.
points: Start from a template or a blank page
Import resume text or an HTML page
Live preview while you edit

routes.title: How Portfolio OS Works — Private, Offline Builder
routes.description: A local-first portfolio and resume builder: no accounts and no uploads. Your data lives in your browser and every export is made on your device.
routes.intro: Portfolio OS is a local-first app. Projects, images and version history live in your browser's own database, and every export (HTML, PDF, Word, ZIP) is generated on your device. There is no server to upload to.
points: No accounts or sign-in
No uploads: data stays in your browser
Installable and works offline
Open file formats you own

routes.title: Resume Job Description Match Checker — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Paste a job description and see which keywords and skills your resume covers, what's missing and a weighted match score. Free, private, runs offline.
routes.h1: Match your resume to a job description
routes.intro: Paste a job posting and pick a resume. Portfolio OS finds the skills, tools and keywords the role asks for, shows which ones your resume already covers, flags the missing ones you already have in your profile, and explains exactly how the match score is calculated.
points: Matched and missing keywords grouped into hard skills, tools, soft skills and other
Weighted match score that counts requirements more than nice-to-haves
Spots skills you have in your profile but left off this resume
Title, seniority and years-of-experience checks
One click to make a tailored copy of the resume for the job

routes.title: Resume Bullet Point Checker — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Check every resume bullet for weak verbs, missing metrics, length, repeated openers, tense, pronouns and passive voice. Free and runs in your browser.
routes.intro: Strong bullets start with an action verb, show a result and fit on one or two lines. The bullet helper reviews every bullet in your resume, or any text you paste, and tells you what to fix with stronger verb suggestions.
points: Flags weak openers like "responsible for" and suggests stronger verbs
Finds bullets with no numbers or measurable results
Catches overlong lines, repeated starting verbs and mixed tenses
Spots first-person pronouns, filler words and passive voice
Works on a saved resume or on pasted text

routes.title: Free Job Application Tracker — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Track job applications from wishlist to offer on a board or list, with dates, contacts, notes and the resume you sent. Private, free and no sign-up.
routes.intro: Keep every role you apply for in one place. Move applications from wishlist to applied, interview and offer, record contacts and next steps, and link the exact resume and cover letter you sent. Everything is stored in your browser.
points: Kanban board and sortable list with search and filters
Response rate, upcoming next steps and stale application alerts
Links each application to the resume and cover letter you sent
Contacts, notes and the full job description for every role
Export to CSV

routes.title: Interview Prep Questions From Your Resume — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Practise interview questions generated from your own experience, projects and skills. Write STAR answers, time them and drill with flashcards.
routes.h1: Interview prep built from your own resume
routes.intro: Portfolio OS turns your experience, projects and skills into the behavioural and technical questions interviewers are likely to ask. Write STAR answers, check how long they take to say, rate your confidence and practise with flashcards.
points: Behavioural questions built from your real roles and projects
Technical questions for the skills on your resume
STAR answer template with word count and speaking time
Confidence ratings and a shuffled flashcard mode
Questions tailored to a saved job application

routes.title: Compare Two Resume Versions — Portfolio OS
routes.description: See exactly what changed between two resume versions: sections, entries, bullets, skills and design, with word-by-word highlights. Free and private.
routes.intro: Tailoring a resume for each job creates many versions. Compare any two side by side or in one merged view and see added, removed and edited sections, entries and bullets, skill differences and design changes.
points: Side-by-side and unified views with an only-changes filter
Word-level highlights for edited summaries and bullets
Added, removed, hidden and reordered sections
Skill set differences and design setting changes
Read-only: nothing in your resumes is changed

routes.title: LinkedIn Headline & About Generator — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Generate a LinkedIn headline, About section, experience text and skills list from your resume profile, sized to LinkedIn's character limits.
routes.h1: LinkedIn headline and About section generator
routes.intro: Turn the profile you already built into ready-to-paste LinkedIn copy. Pick from several headline and About variants, edit them with live character counters, and copy each block into LinkedIn.
points: Headline variants within the 220-character limit
About section in story, concise and skills-focused styles
Experience descriptions formatted for LinkedIn
Deduplicated skills list ordered by strength
Live character counters and one-click copy

routes.title: AI Resume & Cover Letter Assistant — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Optional AI help with your own API key: rewrite resume bullets, draft a cover letter from a job description and get summary and tailoring ideas.
routes.h1: AI resume and cover letter assistant
routes.intro: An optional assistant that uses your own Anthropic API key. Text goes straight from your browser to the model under your account, and it is told to use only the facts you provide and never invent employers, dates or numbers.
points: Rewrite resume bullets in a concise, impact or technical tone
Draft a cover letter from a job description and save it as a document
Professional summary suggestions
Tailoring tips that point to experience you already have
Bring your own key; the rest of the app works without it

routes.title: Back Up & Sync Your Resume Data — Portfolio OS
routes.description: Save every portfolio, resume, document and application to one file or a synced folder, with optional passphrase encryption. Restore on any device.
routes.h1: Back up and sync your data
routes.intro: Portfolio OS keeps your work in your browser. Back up everything to a single file, encrypt it with a passphrase if you like, and restore it on another device, or sync through a folder in iCloud, Dropbox or Google Drive.
points: One file with portfolios, resumes, documents, images and applications
Optional passphrase encryption (AES-GCM)
Merge or replace when restoring, with a preview first
Sync folder support in Chrome and Edge
Saved tokens and API keys never leave the device
